## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run example` pass
- [ ] Behaviour changes have a test that fails without them
- [ ] `docs/guarantees.md` updated if crash or concurrency behaviour changed
- [ ] Public API changes have JSDoc and a CHANGELOG entry
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies in the core
